title: Positivity of a power moment
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $r\in\mathbb R$, and let $u:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be pointwise nonnegative. If $u$ is positive at at least one point, then $\mathbb E[u^r]>0$ under the uniform measure.
replaced: Let $r\in\bbr$ and $u:\{0,1\}^n\to[0,\infty)$ have at least one positive value. Then $\E[u^r]>0$, with the convention $0^0=1$ and $0^r=0$ for $r\ne0$.
